entries.back_en: The dragon ahead... It will soon be reborn, and I will be the one who defeats it again...
entries.note: 'derrota' (defeats) for 'end it' is acceptable; present tense reads naturally.

entries.back_en: Killing... Through it, we came into this world and carved out our path.
entries.note: 'Por ela' slightly gender-odd for infinitive but sense preserved.

entries.back_en: There's something here that seems to reward those like us. You noticed it too... didn't you?
The power that's been with you since you set foot here belongs to all of us. I couldn't wish for a greater destiny than becoming part of it.
Otherwise, how would you have gotten this far?
